_comment: Run template for lbnl-chiller: plant-level kW/ton and cooling-tower approach on chiller/tower 1. The simulated design curves are not published, so each rule's design ceiling is CALIBRATED from the fault_free run's own median (commissioning practice, as examples/lbnl_fdd/benchmark.py does): 1.44 kW/ton and an 8.1 F approach. With the rules' generic defaults every run, including fault_free, would read as a fault.
